hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
# ------------------- # Minimal logging # ------------------- LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
# ------------------- # Config # ------------------- REGION="us-east-1" SECRET_ID='rds!db-8086eb77-cd6d-48bc-9298-4380892798ca'
DB_HOST='dictionarydb.cljahwnkfisu.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com' DB_PORT="5432" DB_USER="postgres" DB_NAME="dictionary_db"
ROLE_ARN="arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl" ROLE_SESSION_NAME="s3-test" ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS="1800"
S3_BUCKET="avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl" S3_PREFIX="general/hpds/javabin"
PG_IMAGE="${PG_IMAGE:-postgres:16-bookworm}" PG_JOBS="${PG_JOBS:-10}"
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; } need aws need jq need docker need tar
WORKDIR="${WORKSPACE:-$PWD}" ts="$(date -u '+%m-%d-%yT%H')" TAR_BASENAME="dictionary_db_${ts}.tar" TAR_NAME="${WORKDIR}/${TAR_BASENAME}" S3_URI="s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${S3_PREFIX}/${TAR_BASENAME}"
cleanup() { rm -f "${assume_json:-}" 2>/dev/null || true unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN } trap cleanup EXIT
rm -f "$TAR_NAME"
# ------------------- # Fetch DB password (host-side) # ------------------- log "Fetching DB password from Secrets Manager (${SECRET_ID})" conn_pass="$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value \ --secret-id "$SECRET_ID" \ --region "$REGION" \ --query SecretString \ --output text | jq -r .password)"
if [[ -z "${conn_pass:-}" || "${conn_pass}" == "null" ]]; then error "Failed to load password from secret ${SECRET_ID}" exit 1 fi
# ------------------- # Run pg_dump in container, stream tar to host # ------------------- log "Running pg_dump in ${PG_IMAGE} (schema=dict) and writing ${TAR_NAME}" docker run --rm \ -e PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" \ "$PG_IMAGE" \ bash -lc " set -euo pipefail
echo 'Testing connection...' >&2 psql --host='$DB_HOST' --port='$DB_PORT' --username='$DB_USER' --dbname='$DB_NAME' -c '\\q' >&2 echo 'Connection test successful!' >&2
rm -rf /tmp/dictionary_db.sql pg_dump \ --host='$DB_HOST' \ --port='$DB_PORT' \ --username='$DB_USER' \ --format=d \ --file=/tmp/dictionary_db.sql \ --jobs='${PG_JOBS}' \ --verbose \ --no-owner --no-privileges --no-tablespaces --no-unlogged-table-data --no-comments \ --no-publications --no-subscriptions --no-security-labels --no-toast-compression --no-table-access-method \ --schema=dict \ '$DB_NAME' >&2
# tar bytes to STDOUT only tar -C /tmp -cf - dictionary_db.sql " > "$TAR_NAME"
# sanity checks if [[ ! -s "$TAR_NAME" ]]; then error "Dump tar was not created or is empty: $TAR_NAME" exit 1 fi log "Dump tar created (bytes=$(wc -c < "$TAR_NAME"))" log "Tar contents (first 25):" tar -tf "$TAR_NAME" | head -n 25 >&2
# ------------------- # Assume role + upload # ------------------- log "Assuming role for S3 upload: ${ROLE_ARN}" assume_json="$(mktemp)" aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS" \ --role-arn "$ROLE_ARN" \ --role-session-name "$ROLE_SESSION_NAME" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")"
log "Uploading to ${S3_URI}" aws s3 cp "$TAR_NAME" "$S3_URI" --no-progress
echo "$S3_URI" > "${WORKDIR}/db_dump_name.txt" log "Uploaded: ${S3_URI}"
